58cf17cc9faeeb340755.en: This incident is deeply troubling, not only because of the impact of the high-pressure water cannon, but also because of the complex logic and potential risks behind it. On National Day, such a symbol of national pride and unity, a heartbreaking accident occurred in the Dongsha Sea.
